answer.reason: The BLS QCEW Indiana statewide private-sector Q4 2024 row for NAICS 54 corresponds to December employment of 171,342 covered jobs, matching option A.

metadata.prompt:
Question: In the BLS QCEW fourth-quarter 2024 data for Indiana, what was the December 2024 private-sector employment level, in covered jobs, for NAICS 54 Professional, scientific, and technical services?

A. 171,342 covered jobs
B. 150,679 covered jobs

Source citation: BLS QCEW Open Data, Indiana statewide, 2024 Q4 (https://data.bls.gov/cew/data/api/2024/4/area/18000.csv)

Supplied draft answer: A
